summary: Eight criminal cases were opened in Fairbanks-area courts on Nov. 13 - seven at Fairbanks and one at Delta Junction. They include court files behind the five arrests Alaska State Troopers reported on Nov. 12 and behind two theft arrests reported by Fairbanks Police. Troopers also reported a domestic violence assault arrest in Fairbanks on Nov. 13 and a second death investigation, at North Pole. A felony theft case filed in October against a Fairbanks man, who was indicted on Nov. 4, records an arrest on Nov. 12. The court filing counts below are the Alaska Court System weekly charges report's own counts for its window of Nov. 6 to Nov. 12; that window closes before Nov. 13, so the report carries none of the day's eight new cases.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest: Catherine Mutchler
body: Catherine Mutchler, 62, of Fairbanks, is charged with assault in the fourth degree - recklessly injuring another person - a Class A misdemeanor.

Troopers say they responded to a Fairbanks residence at 7:44 a.m. on Nov. 13 for a reported domestic disturbance, that she assaulted a household member, and that she was arrested and taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. The trooper release states the charge as domestic violence; the court file records the count as not domestic violence related.
Case 4FA-26-02283CR; charged by information, arraigned Nov. 13, next court date Jan. 7, 2027.

entries.title: Death investigation at North Pole
body: Alaska State Troopers say they responded on Nov. 13 to an address in North Pole for a report of an unexpected death, and that Rodney Mcintosh, 63, of North Pole, had died. Troopers say next of kin have been notified and the investigation is continuing.
No cause or manner of death is stated. No arrest or charge is reported and no court case has been opened.

entries.title: Death investigation off Chena Hot Springs Road
body: Alaska State Troopers say they responded at 9:06 p.m. on Nov. 12 to a residence off Chena Hot Springs Road to investigate a death, and that Shawn Hamm, 26, of Fairbanks, had died. Troopers say next of kin have been notified.
No cause or manner of death is stated, and no arrest or charge is reported. No court case has been opened.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Breanna Franks
body: Breanna Franks was issued a criminal summons for driving while her license was revoked, and a citation for failing to provide proof of insurance.

Troopers say they stopped a car near South Cushman Street and Twenty-Fourth Avenue at about 1:28 a.m. on Nov. 13 after it failed to signal a lane change, and that records showed a revoked license and a prior conviction for the same offense in 2020. No arrest is reported.
No court case has been opened.

entries.title: Felony theft arrest: Noel Showwalter Curtis
body: Noel Showwalter Curtis, 34, is charged with theft in the second degree - taking property worth $750 to $24,999 - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years.

According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested on that charge at the 100 block of Lacey Street on Nov. 12. The charge was filed by complaint on Oct. 29 over an offense dated Oct. 19 at Fairbanks, and a summons had been issued to troopers on Oct. 30.

Case 4FA-26-02195CR. A grand jury indicted him on Nov. 4 and the case was transferred to the Superior Court. The court record shows counsel appointed from the bench and a hearing on quashing a warrant, both on Nov. 12, and the summons canceled. A felony pretrial order takes effect Nov. 25.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Jason Clark
body: Jason Clark, 37, of Delta Junction, is charged with assault in the second degree - intentionally injuring someone with a dangerous instrument - a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years, and with assault in the third degree - injuring someone with a dangerous instrument - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. Three further counts are Class A misdemeanors: assault in the fourth degree, assault committed in the presence of a child, and interfering with a report of a domestic violence crime. All five counts are recorded as domestic violence related.

Troopers say they responded to a reported assault at Delta Junction at about 10:55 p.m. on Nov. 11, that Clark had assaulted his domestic partner, and that he was arrested and taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4DJ-26-00072CR; arraigned Nov. 12, preliminary hearings Nov. 19 and Dec. 2, pre-trial conference Dec. 31 and a trial week beginning Jan. 11, 2027.

entries.title: Felony assault arrest: Luke Emanuel Afcan
body: Luke Emanuel Afcan, 42, is charged with assault in the third degree - recklessly putting someone in fear of serious injury with a weapon - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. The count is not recorded as domestic violence related.

According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 500 block of First Avenue at 2:19 a.m. on Nov. 12. The bulletin records an aggravated assault with a cutting instrument at the same block shortly after 2 a.m. under the same case number.
Case 4FA-26-02275CR; arraigned Nov. 12, preliminary hearings Nov. 19 and Dec. 2.

entries.title: Felony DUI arrest: Brian Edward Fay
body: Brian Edward Fay, 49, is charged with felony driving under the influence and felony refusal to submit to a chemical test - each carrying the felony grade because the court file records two or more prior convictions - both Class C felonies, punishable by up to five years.
According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 400 block of Harold Bentley Avenue at 1:24 a.m. on Nov. 12, after an incident recorded there as driving under the influence shortly after 1 a.m.
Case 4FA-26-02277CR; arraigned Nov. 12, preliminary hearings Nov. 19 and Dec. 2.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Anthony Cooper
body: Anthony Henry Cooper is charged with driving under the influence with a blood alcohol content of .08 percent or more, a Class A misdemeanor.

Troopers say they stopped him near Holmes Road and Dennis Road at about 6:08 p.m. on Nov. 12 after seeing him fail to stop at a stop sign, and that a breath sample measured 0.163 grams per 210 liters.
Case 4FA-26-02280CR, opened at Fairbanks on Nov. 13 over an offense recorded at North Pole. A complaint was filed the same day and a $500 cash bond is recorded as posted. No hearing date is set.

entries.title: DUI and weapons arrest: Lucas Baghdassarian
body: Lucas Baghdassarian, 24, of Illinois, is charged with driving under the influence with a blood alcohol content of .08 percent or more, and with misconduct involving weapons in the fourth degree - carrying a weapon while intoxicated. Both are Class A misdemeanors.
Troopers say they went to Chena Ridge Road at Moonshine Run at about 7:08 p.m. on Nov. 12 for a single-vehicle rollover, and that he was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02281CR, opened at Fairbanks on Nov. 13. A complaint was filed and he was released on the standing schedule the same day.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Dezmond Eagleshield
body: Dezmond Carl Eagleshield, 20, of Fairbanks, is charged with driving under the influence with a blood alcohol content of .08 percent or more, a Class A misdemeanor, and with violating conditions of release in a misdemeanor case, a Class B misdemeanor.
Troopers say they stopped the vehicle near Wilbur Street and Airport Way at about 4:55 p.m. on Nov. 12, and that he was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02282CR, opened at Fairbanks on Nov. 13 and arraigned the same day.

entries.title: Warrant arrest: Marshall Haworth
body: Marshall Haworth, 18, of Fairbanks, was arrested on a bench warrant for failing to appear in court.
Troopers say they contacted him in the area of South Cushman Extension at about 3:37 p.m. on Nov. 12 and took him to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. No new court case has been opened.

entries.title: Theft arrests on the Johansen Expressway: Kimberly Ann Evans and Benjamin Leath Rivers
body: Kimberly Ann Evans, 31, and Benjamin Leath Rivers, 47, were arrested on charges of theft in the fourth degree - taking property worth less than $250 - recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
According to Fairbanks Police, both were arrested at the 500 block of the Johansen Expressway on Nov. 12, at 5:30 p.m. and 5:44 p.m., under case 26003444.

Court numbers 4FA-26-02278CR and 4FA-26-02279CR were opened at Fairbanks on Nov. 13. Neither file carries a charging document yet, so neither states a charge class; both were released on the standing schedule.

entries.title: Assault reported on Twelfth Avenue
body: Fairbanks Police record an assault at the 500 block of Twelfth Avenue shortly after 11 p.m. on Nov. 12, under case 26003446. No arrest is recorded and nobody is named.

entries.title: Assault charge: Robin Judon
body: Robin Judon is charged with assault in the fourth degree - recklessly injuring another person - a Class A misdemeanor. The count is not recorded as domestic violence related.
The offense is recorded at Fairbanks on Nov. 13. Case 4FA-26-02284CR; a charging document was filed and the case arraigned the same day.

entries.title: Criminal mischief charge: Talissa Lynn Solomon
body: Talissa Lynn Solomon is charged with criminal mischief in the fourth degree - damaging property worth $250 to $749 - a Class A misdemeanor. The count is not recorded as domestic violence related.
The offense is recorded at Delta Junction on Nov. 12. Case 4DJ-26-00073CR; charged by information and arraigned at Delta Junction on Nov. 13.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license charge: Rita Carol Bennett
body: Rita Carol Bennett is charged with driving with a canceled, revoked or suspended license after a previous conviction, a Class A misdemeanor, and with operating a vehicle without liability insurance, a misdemeanor the statute does not classify.
The offense is recorded at Fairbanks on Nov. 10. Case 4FA-26-02268CR; the charging document was filed Nov. 11 and she was released on the standing schedule on Nov. 12.

entries.title: Indecent exposure arrest: Aron Lloyd Forbes
body: Aron Lloyd Forbes, 21, was arrested on a charge of indecent exposure in the second degree - exposure before a person aged 16 or over - recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 100 block of Lacey Street on Nov. 10, under case 26002690. No court case has been opened.

entries.title: Violating a protective order: Curtis Ian McDonald
body: Curtis Ian McDonald, 60, was arrested on a charge of violating a domestic violence protective order, recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
According to Fairbanks Police, he was arrested at the 100 block of Lacey Street on Nov. 10, under case 26002964. No court case has been opened.

entries.title: Leaving the scene of a crash: Charity Elaine Ludvick
body: Charity Elaine Ludvick, 36, was arrested on a charge of leaving the scene of a property-damage accident in a non-commercial vehicle, recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
According to Fairbanks Police, she was arrested at the 100 block of Lacey Street on Nov. 9, under case 26002773. No court case has been opened.
